name: rn-swiftui-turbo-bridge
description: Typed React Native TurboModule and native SwiftUI telemetry surfaces

scripts.codegen: mkdir -p /tmp/telemetry-codegen && node node_modules/@react-native/codegen/lib/cli/combine/combine-js-to-schema-cli.js /tmp/telemetry-codegen/schema.json src/specs/NativeTelemetryBridge.ts && node node_modules/react-native/scripts/generate-specs-cli.js --platform ios --schemaPath /tmp/telemetry-codegen/schema.json --outputDir /tmp/telemetry-codegen --libraryName TelemetryBridgeSpec --libraryType modules

author: Julian Khatibi
